title: Verify Initial Load and Form Pre-population for Case 1 (Current/Future Period)
behavior: Verify Initial Load and Form Pre-population for Case 1 (Current/Future Period). Expected behavior: 1. GET endpoint 14.3 executes successfully and pre-fills form data without reshaping. 2. Breadcrumb displays 'Manajemen Insentif / Tipe Insentif / Edit Tipe Insentif'. 3. Header shows status 'Aktif' (or relevant status) and 'By Product Stock Level' (incentive point name) as read-only labels. 4. 'Berlaku sejak' and 'Berlaku sampai' date pickers are populated and both are editable. 5. Channels, Tipe Salesman dropdowns (with level-label mapping: 1->Sales, 2->SPV/KAO, 3->RSO), slab rows (No, Simbol, Target, Nilai), '+ Tipe Salesman', '+ Tambah Channel', and delete icons are fully editable and active.
precondition: User is authenticated and navigates to 'Edit Tipe Insentif' screen for a config where valid_from and valid_to are both in the current or future period (Case 1).
test_steps:
1. Access the Edit screen for the specified Case 1 incentive point configuration.
2. Observe breadcrumb, header status, and Tipe Insentif title.
3. Observe the 'Skema Insentif' period fields ('Berlaku sejak' and 'Berlaku sampai').
4. Observe the 'Pilih Channel dan Tipe Salesman' section, including Channel boxes, Salesman dropdowns, slab table rows, and action controls.
expected_result:
1. GET endpoint 14.3 executes successfully and pre-fills form data without reshaping.
2. Breadcrumb displays 'Manajemen Insentif / Tipe Insentif / Edit Tipe Insentif'.
3. Header shows status 'Aktif' (or relevant status) and 'By Product Stock Level' (incentive point name) as read-only labels.
4. 'Berlaku sejak' and 'Berlaku sampai' date pickers are populated and both are editable.
5. Channels, Tipe Salesman dropdowns (with level-label mapping: 1->Sales, 2->SPV/KAO, 3->RSO), slab rows (No, Simbol, Target, Nilai), '+ Tipe Salesman', '+ Tambah Channel', and delete icons are fully editable and active.

title: Verify Case 2 Restrictions (valid_from in Past, valid_to in Current/Future)
behavior: Verify Case 2 Restrictions (valid_from in Past, valid_to in Current/Future). Expected behavior: 1. 'Berlaku sejak' field is disabled and read-only. 2. 'Berlaku sampai' field remains active and editable. 3. The entire 'Pilih Channel dan Tipe Salesman' section is rendered read-only. 4. Controls '+ Tambah Channel', '+ Tipe Salesman', slab table row inputs, minus icons, and trash delete icons are hidden or disabled. 5. Dirty tracking ensures is_slabs_updated is always false for this configuration.
precondition: User is authenticated and navigates to 'Edit Tipe Insentif' for a config where valid_from is in the past, but valid_to is current or future (Case 2).
test_steps:
1. Open the Edit Tipe Insentif page for the Case 2 configuration.
2. Inspect the 'Berlaku sejak' input field.
3. Inspect the 'Berlaku sampai' input field.
4. Inspect the 'Pilih Channel dan Tipe Salesman' section, including slab tables, add buttons, and delete icons.
expected_result:
1. 'Berlaku sejak' field is disabled and read-only.
2. 'Berlaku sampai' field remains active and editable.
3. The entire 'Pilih Channel dan Tipe Salesman' section is rendered read-only.
4. Controls '+ Tambah Channel', '+ Tipe Salesman', slab table row inputs, minus icons, and trash delete icons are hidden or disabled.
5. Dirty tracking ensures is_slabs_updated is always false for this configuration.

title: Verify Case 3 Restriction: Edit Option Hidden and Edit URL Not Reachable
behavior: Verify Case 3 Restriction: Edit Option Hidden and Edit URL Not Reachable. Expected behavior: 1. The 'Edit' option is completely absent/omitted from 'Pilih Aksi' dropdown. 2. Navigating directly to the URL blocks editing by redirecting to the list screen or displaying the EDIT_NOT_PERMITTED error banner.
precondition: User is authenticated and slab config exists where both valid_from and valid_to are in the past (Case 3).
test_steps:
1. Navigate to the Tipe Insentif list screen.
2. Locate the expired Case 3 record and click 'Pilih Aksi'.
3. Attempt to directly enter the edit URL for this Case 3 configuration ID in the browser address bar.
expected_result:
1. The 'Edit' option is completely absent/omitted from 'Pilih Aksi' dropdown.
2. Navigating directly to the URL blocks editing by redirecting to the list screen or displaying the EDIT_NOT_PERMITTED error banner.

title: Verify Save Button Behavior in Pristine State (No Changes Made)
behavior: Verify Save Button Behavior in Pristine State (No Changes Made). Expected behavior: 1. Dirty tracking evaluates both is_config_updated and is_slabs_updated as false. 2. 'Simpan' button is visually disabled or acts as a non-interactive no-op. 3. Clicking 'Simpan' does not open a confirmation modal and triggers no network PATCH request.
precondition: User opens an editable Case 1 config in 'Edit Tipe Insentif' screen.
test_steps:
1. Wait for form to pre-fill all fetched config data.
2. Do not modify any date, channel, salesman type, or slab table value.
3. Check the state and interactivity of the 'Simpan' button.
expected_result:
1. Dirty tracking evaluates both is_config_updated and is_slabs_updated as false.
2. 'Simpan' button is visually disabled or acts as a non-interactive no-op.
3. Clicking 'Simpan' does not open a confirmation modal and triggers no network PATCH request.

title: Verify Request Payload When Only Validity Period is Changed
behavior: Verify Request Payload When Only Validity Period is Changed. Expected behavior: 1. Modal 'Simpan Tipe Insentif' opens upon clicking 'Simpan'. 2. PATCH request is triggered with is_config_updated: true and is_slabs_updated: false. 3. Payload contains updated_valid_from and updated_valid_to. 4. The 'groups' array is completely omitted from the request payload. 5. Toast 'Tipe insentif berhasil diubah' appears and user is redirected to list screen.
precondition: User is on 'Edit Tipe Insentif' screen for a Case 1 config.
test_steps:
1. Change 'Berlaku sampai' to a new valid future date.
2. Ensure no channel, salesman group, or slab value is modified.
3. Click 'Simpan'.
4. Click 'Ya, Simpan' in the confirmation modal.
expected_result:
1. Modal 'Simpan Tipe Insentif' opens upon clicking 'Simpan'.
2. PATCH request is triggered with is_config_updated: true and is_slabs_updated: false.
3. Payload contains updated_valid_from and updated_valid_to.
4. The 'groups' array is completely omitted from the request payload.
5. Toast 'Tipe insentif berhasil diubah' appears and user is redirected to list screen.

title: Verify Request Payload When Only Slab Values/Groups are Changed
behavior: Verify Request Payload When Only Slab Values/Groups are Changed. Expected behavior: 1. Modal 'Simpan Tipe Insentif' opens. 2. PATCH request is sent with is_config_updated: false and is_slabs_updated: true. 3. Payload includes the full current 'groups' array with modified slab data. 4. updated_valid_from and updated_valid_to are omitted from the PATCH payload. 5. Toast 'Tipe insentif berhasil diubah' is displayed and user is redirected to list screen.
precondition: User is on 'Edit Tipe Insentif' screen for a Case 1 config.
test_steps:
1. Keep 'Berlaku sejak' and 'Berlaku sampai' unchanged.
2. Modify Target or Nilai (Skor) inside one of the slab rows.
3. Click 'Simpan'.
4. Click 'Ya, Simpan' in the confirmation modal.
expected_result:
1. Modal 'Simpan Tipe Insentif' opens.
2. PATCH request is sent with is_config_updated: false and is_slabs_updated: true.
3. Payload includes the full current 'groups' array with modified slab data.
4. updated_valid_from and updated_valid_to are omitted from the PATCH payload.
5. Toast 'Tipe insentif berhasil diubah' is displayed and user is redirected to list screen.

title: Verify Request Payload When Both Period and Slabs are Changed
behavior: Verify Request Payload When Both Period and Slabs are Changed. Expected behavior: 1. Modal 'Simpan Tipe Insentif' appears. 2. PATCH request executes with is_config_updated: true and is_slabs_updated: true. 3. Payload contains updated_valid_from, updated_valid_to, and the complete 'groups' array containing the newly added slab row. 4. Success toast 'Tipe insentif berhasil diubah' appears and user is navigated to list screen.
precondition: User is on 'Edit Tipe Insentif' screen for a Case 1 config.
test_steps:
1. Update 'Berlaku sampai' date picker value.
2. Click the '+' icon on the last slab row to append a new slab row.
3. Enter valid Operator, Target, and Nilai in the new row.
4. Click 'Simpan'.
5. Confirm by clicking 'Ya, Simpan' in the modal.
expected_result:
1. Modal 'Simpan Tipe Insentif' appears.
2. PATCH request executes with is_config_updated: true and is_slabs_updated: true.
3. Payload contains updated_valid_from, updated_valid_to, and the complete 'groups' array containing the newly added slab row.
4. Success toast 'Tipe insentif berhasil diubah' appears and user is navigated to list screen.

title: Verify Deletion of Slab Row and Group Triggers Full-Replace Omission
behavior: Verify Deletion of Slab Row and Group Triggers Full-Replace Omission. Expected behavior: 1. The deleted slab row is removed immediately from the UI table. 2. The deleted group box is removed immediately from the UI. 3. PATCH request is triggered with is_slabs_updated: true. 4. Payload 'groups' array contains only the remaining groups and slabs, omitting deleted entries to enforce full-replace deprecation on backend.
precondition: User opens an editable Case 1 config with multiple channels, groups, and slab rows.
test_steps:
1. Click the minus ('-') icon on a specific slab row to remove it.
2. Click the trash delete icon on a salesman group box to remove that entire group.
3. Click 'Simpan' and confirm 'Ya, Simpan'.
expected_result:
1. The deleted slab row is removed immediately from the UI table.
2. The deleted group box is removed immediately from the UI.
3. PATCH request is triggered with is_slabs_updated: true.
4. Payload 'groups' array contains only the remaining groups and slabs, omitting deleted entries to enforce full-replace deprecation on backend.

title: Verify Edit Screen Layout for Non-Channel Flow (requires_channel = false)
behavior: Verify Edit Screen Layout for Non-Channel Flow (requires_channel = false). Expected behavior: 1. No Channel dropdown boxes or '+ Tambah Channel' button are rendered on the page. 2. 'Tipe Salesman' boxes are rendered directly beneath 'Skema Insentif'. 3. Local slab modifications update properly. 4. PATCH request sends updated groups without channel mappings, toast 'Tipe insentif berhasil diubah' appears, and redirect occurs.
precondition: User navigates to Edit Tipe Insentif for an incentive point where requires_channel is false.
test_steps:
1. Observe the UI layout of the Edit page.
2. Check for the presence of '1. Channel' dropdown and '+ Tambah Channel' button.
3. Edit slab values within the salesman group.
4. Click 'Simpan' and confirm 'Ya, Simpan'.
expected_result:
1. No Channel dropdown boxes or '+ Tambah Channel' button are rendered on the page.
2. 'Tipe Salesman' boxes are rendered directly beneath 'Skema Insentif'.
3. Local slab modifications update properly.
4. PATCH request sends updated groups without channel mappings, toast 'Tipe insentif berhasil diubah' appears, and redirect occurs.

title: Verify Client-Side Validation: updated_valid_to Earlier Than updated_valid_from
behavior: Verify Client-Side Validation: updated_valid_to Earlier Than updated_valid_from. Expected behavior: 1. Date picker sets the invalid date. 2. Client-side error message is displayed on 'Berlaku sampai' indicating it cannot be earlier than 'Berlaku sejak'. 3. 'Simpan' button remains disabled or blocks form submission.
precondition: User is on the Edit Tipe Insentif screen (Case 1).
test_steps:
1. Select a 'Berlaku sampai' date that is strictly earlier than 'Berlaku sejak'.
2. Observe the field validation message.
3. Attempt to click 'Simpan'.
expected_result:
1. Date picker sets the invalid date.
2. Client-side error message is displayed on 'Berlaku sampai' indicating it cannot be earlier than 'Berlaku sejak'.
3. 'Simpan' button remains disabled or blocks form submission.

title: Verify Client-Side Validation: Duplicate Channel and Salesperson Combination Blocked
behavior: Verify Client-Side Validation: Duplicate Channel and Salesperson Combination Blocked. Expected behavior: 1. Client-side validation triggers an error indicating duplicate combination of channel, salesperson type, and level. 2. The duplicate group field is highlighted. 3. Submission is blocked and no PATCH request is sent.
precondition: User is on 'Edit Tipe Insentif' screen where Channel 'Trader' and Tipe Salesman 'SMO (Modern Sales)' (Level 1) already exist.
test_steps:
1. Click '+ Tipe Salesman' under Channel 'Trader'.
2. Select 'SMO (Modern Sales)' with the identical level (Level 1) in the new group box.
3. Attempt to save the form.
expected_result:
1. Client-side validation triggers an error indicating duplicate combination of channel, salesperson type, and level.
2. The duplicate group field is highlighted.
3. Submission is blocked and no PATCH request is sent.

title: Verify Client-Side Validation: Duplicate (Operator, Value) Within Same Group Blocked
behavior: Verify Client-Side Validation: Duplicate (Operator, Value) Within Same Group Blocked. Expected behavior: 1. Inline validation error is displayed flagging duplicate operator and target value within the same group. 2. Form submission is blocked and no PATCH request is sent.
precondition: User is editing a slab table with an existing row having operator '>' and target '4'.
test_steps:
1. Click the '+' button to add a new slab row in the same group.
2. Select operator '>' from the Simbol dropdown.
3. Enter value '4' in the Target (hari) field.
4. Enter any valid Nilai (Skor) and attempt to save.
expected_result:
1. Inline validation error is displayed flagging duplicate operator and target value within the same group.
2. Form submission is blocked and no PATCH request is sent.

title: Verify Slab Table Allows Same Value with Different Operators
behavior: Verify Slab Table Allows Same Value with Different Operators. Expected behavior: 1. Row accepts the operator '<=' and value '4' without any duplicate error. 2. Form validation passes successfully. 3. Confirmation modal opens and PATCH request submits the distinct operator/value pairs.
precondition: User is editing a slab table with an existing row having operator '>' and target '4'.
test_steps:
1. Click the '+' button to add a new slab row in the same group.
2. Select operator '<=' from the Simbol dropdown.
3. Enter value '4' in the Target (hari) field and '2' in Nilai (Skor).
4. Click 'Simpan' and confirm 'Ya, Simpan' in the modal.
expected_result:
1. Row accepts the operator '<=' and value '4' without any duplicate error.
2. Form validation passes successfully.
3. Confirmation modal opens and PATCH request submits the distinct operator/value pairs.

title: Verify Cancel Flow: 'Batal' Modal and Discard Changes
behavior: Verify Cancel Flow: 'Batal' Modal and Discard Changes. Expected behavior: 1. Confirmation modal with title 'Batal Simpan Tipe Insentif?' opens. 2. User is presented with options to cancel/stay or discard changes. 3. Clicking 'Batalkan Perubahan' discards all unsaved modifications, makes no PATCH call, and redirects user back to the list screen.
precondition: User has made modifications to the form on 'Edit Tipe Insentif' screen.
test_steps:
1. Click the 'Batal' button in the top right header.
2. Observe the modal dialogue displayed.
3. Click 'Batalkan Perubahan' in the modal.
expected_result:
1. Confirmation modal with title 'Batal Simpan Tipe Insentif?' opens.
2. User is presented with options to cancel/stay or discard changes.
3. Clicking 'Batalkan Perubahan' discards all unsaved modifications, makes no PATCH call, and redirects user back to the list screen.

title: Verify Full-Page Error State on Missing Incentive Point or Slab Set
behavior: Verify Full-Page Error State on Missing Incentive Point or Slab Set. Expected behavior: 1. Edit form is not rendered. 2. A full-page error state is displayed informing the user that the incentive point or slab set was not found.
precondition: User navigates to Edit Tipe Insentif using a URL with a non-existent or invalid ID.
test_steps:
1. Load the edit page with an invalid incentive point ID or slab config ID.
2. Observe server response 14.3 returning INCENTIVE_POINT_NOT_FOUND or SLAB_SET_NOT_FOUND.
3. Observe UI screen display.
expected_result:
1. Edit form is not rendered.
2. A full-page error state is displayed informing the user that the incentive point or slab set was not found.

title: Verify Server Error Handling: CONFIG_OVERLAP and CONFIG_CHANGE_RUN_IN_PROGRESS
behavior: Verify Server Error Handling: CONFIG_OVERLAP and CONFIG_CHANGE_RUN_IN_PROGRESS. Expected behavior: 1. On CONFIG_OVERLAP: Period fields are highlighted in error state and a config-level error banner is displayed. 2. On CONFIG_CHANGE_RUN_IN_PROGRESS: A full-form error banner is displayed stating calculation is in progress, and further save actions are blocked.
precondition: User submits modifications on the Edit screen.
test_steps:
1. Modify valid period dates to overlap with an existing period and click 'Simpan' -> 'Ya, Simpan' (Mocking CONFIG_OVERLAP response).
2. Observe period fields and screen banner.
3. Resubmit changes while a calculation run is active (Mocking CONFIG_CHANGE_RUN_IN_PROGRESS response).
4. Observe error banner and save button state.
expected_result:
1. On CONFIG_OVERLAP: Period fields are highlighted in error state and a config-level error banner is displayed.
2. On CONFIG_CHANGE_RUN_IN_PROGRESS: A full-form error banner is displayed stating calculation is in progress, and further save actions are blocked.

title: Verify Client-Side Validation: updated_valid_to Earlier Than updated_valid_from
behavior: Verify Client-Side Validation: updated_valid_to Earlier Than updated_valid_from. Expected behavior: 1. An inline validation error message appears on 'Berlaku sampai' indicating that it cannot be earlier than 'Berlaku sejak'. 2. 'Simpan' button is disabled or prevents submission if clicked, and no PATCH call is made.
precondition: User is on 'Edit Tipe Insentif' screen for a Case 1 config.
test_steps:
1. Set 'Berlaku sejak' to a specific future date (e.g., Februari 2026).
2. Set 'Berlaku sampai' to a date earlier than 'Berlaku sejak' (e.g., Januari 2026).
3. Check field validation message and 'Simpan' button state.
expected_result:
1. An inline validation error message appears on 'Berlaku sampai' indicating that it cannot be earlier than 'Berlaku sejak'.
2. 'Simpan' button is disabled or prevents submission if clicked, and no PATCH call is made.

title: Verify Server Error Handling: Safety Nets for EDIT_NOT_PERMITTED, SLABS_NOT_EDITABLE, and VALID_FROM_NOT_EDITABLE
behavior: Verify Server Error Handling: Safety Nets for EDIT_NOT_PERMITTED, SLABS_NOT_EDITABLE, and VALID_FROM_NOT_EDITABLE. Expected behavior: 1. EDIT_NOT_PERMITTED surfaces as a full-form error banner. 2. SLABS_NOT_EDITABLE surfaces as a banner directly above the slab section. 3. VALID_FROM_NOT_EDITABLE surfaces as an inline field error on 'Berlaku sejak'.
precondition: User triggers PATCH submission where backend safety-net business rules fail.
test_steps:
1. Simulate backend returning EDIT_NOT_PERMITTED on save.
2. Observe error presentation.
3. Simulate backend returning SLABS_NOT_EDITABLE on save (e.g. Case 2 bypass attempt).
4. Observe slab section presentation.
5. Simulate backend returning VALID_FROM_NOT_EDITABLE on save.
expected_result:
1. EDIT_NOT_PERMITTED surfaces as a full-form error banner.
2. SLABS_NOT_EDITABLE surfaces as a banner directly above the slab section.
3. VALID_FROM_NOT_EDITABLE surfaces as an inline field error on 'Berlaku sejak'.

title: Verify Server Error Handling: SLAB_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_DEDUCTION_COMPONENT and VALIDATION_ERROR
behavior: Verify Server Error Handling: SLAB_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_DEDUCTION_COMPONENT and VALIDATION_ERROR. Expected behavior: 1. SLAB_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_DEDUCTION_COMPONENT displays as a full-form banner. 2. VALIDATION_ERROR highlights the relevant field(s) with the appropriate inline error message.
precondition: User submits modifications on the Edit screen.
test_steps:
1. Submit form where backend returns SLAB_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_DEDUCTION_COMPONENT.
2. Observe error presentation.
3. Submit form where backend returns VALIDATION_ERROR with specific field targets.
4. Observe field level presentation.
expected_result:
1. SLAB_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_DEDUCTION_COMPONENT displays as a full-form banner.
2. VALIDATION_ERROR highlights the relevant field(s) with the appropriate inline error message.
